title: Calibration ball transfer
task: Pick a reference ball from its stock cradle with the Panda Hand, place it on the weighing pan and park the robot after the load settles.
planner: Enumerate release offsets, minimize the carried distance and solve bounded seven-joint inverse kinematics. The guarded plan requires the ball center to land inside the locating seat. The nominal plan chooses the nearest reachable pan point.
criterion: After the ball has loaded the pan, the center passes the downhill edge without a supporting pan contact.
detail_target: Ball, hinged pan and rubber-lined catch tray

steps.text: Start with the inspection ball resting in the stock cradle and the hand open.
Move over the cradle, then lower both fingers on opposite sides of the ball.
Close the Panda Hand and build contact on both finger pads.
Lift the ball free of its cradle.
Transfer the ball above the central seat.
Lower the ball to the selected release height.
Open both fingers. The ball is free to move under gravity and contact forces.
Retract the open hand above the pan.
Return the unladen arm to its park pose.
Check the final support and settled motion.

safe.summary: The ball settles in the central seat.
safe.caption: The calibration ball rests on the pan after the hand withdraws.

steps.text: Start with the inspection ball resting in the stock cradle and the hand open.
Move over the cradle, then lower both fingers on opposite sides of the ball.
Close the Panda Hand and build contact on both finger pads.
Lift the ball free of its cradle.
Select the shortest transfer to an off-center point on the weighing pan.
Lower the ball to the selected release height.
Open both fingers. The ball is free to move under gravity and contact forces.
Retract the open hand above the pan.
Return the unladen arm to its park pose.
Check the final support and settled motion.

unsafe.summary: The ball rolls off the tipped pan into the catch tray.
unsafe.caption: The loose ball has rolled off the discharge edge into the rubber-lined catch tray.

revision.goal: After release and arm parking, the ball rests on the pan within three degrees, with its speed below 8 mm/s and spin below 0.2 rad/s for at least 0.45 s.
channels: Calibration ball / pan and locating seat
revision.roll_physics: The ball is a free six-DOF rigid body for the full cycle. Pickup, transport and release use only gravity, frictional contact and the original actuated finger joints. All subsequent spin, pan deflection and tray contact emerge from forward dynamics.

revision_actions: Retain the PACE-scaled ball pickup, release, and retract trajectory.
Perform a smooth parked-pose secondary inspection motion in a distinct direction during the terminal park interval and return to the exact parked pose.
